root_cause: On the ARM64 CPU functional tests job, the ACL (Arm Compute Library) executor selection path chose an undefined primitive descriptor (undef_f32) instead of the expected acl_f32 for a MatMulDecompressConvertTest case (3D FC, transpose_a=1, weight decompression, f32). The PR under test (#37885) only touches src/frontends/ir/src/input_model.cpp to pass weights by const reference in the IR frontend's input model, which has no relation to the CPU plugin's ACL executor/primitive-selection logic exercised by this test. The identical assertion (primTypeCheck(primType) is unexpected, undef_f32 vs acl_f32) was already recorded once before on 2026-09-11 for an unrelated PR (#37783, MaxPoolV8), confirming this is a recurring, intermittent ACL primitive-selection issue on ARM64 rather than a regression caused by this PR.
reproduction_steps: On an ARM64 (aarch64) build with ACL enabled, run: ./ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*smoke_FC_3D_FP32/MatMulDecompressConvertTest.CompareWithRefs* repeatedly; the primTypeCheck failure is intermittent and depends on ACL's internal primitive-descriptor resolution for specific weight-decompression/transpose parameter combinations.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed CPU functional tests job to confirm the failure clears on retry (PR #37885's changes are unrelated to the CPU/ACL executor code path).

If the failure reproduces consistently, triage against the CPU plugin ACL executor/primitive-selection code (src/plugins/intel_cpu/src/nodes/executors/acl/*) for MatMul with decompressed f32 weights and transpose_a=1.

Track this as a known intermittent ACL primitive-selection issue (now seen twice with the same undef_f32 vs acl_f32 mismatch across different ops) and consider a temporary skip/quarantine on ARM64 if it keeps recurring.
prevention_strategies: Add CI-level quarantine/tracking for intermittently-failing ACL primitive-selection tests on ARM64 so a single flaky assertion does not block unrelated merge-queue PRs; investigate stabilizing ACL primitive-type resolution for decompressed-weight MatMul configurations.
historical_context: Identical signature (primType is unexpected undef_f32 Expected acl_f32, Flaky Test) previously recorded on 2026-09-11 for smoke_MaxPoolV8_CPU_4D on PR #37783 (pattern eb0b94c864ee1a85, now count=2). A related but distinct primType mismatch (unknown vs ref) was also seen on 2026-07-17 for smoke_ConvertCPULayerTest (pattern 76751669c7a78fcd).
